caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).
model_annotation: The bar chart displays the average performance percentages of various large language models across both knowledge-grounded discussion summarization (KGDS) patterns, with each bar representing a distinct model and its corresponding average performance score. The horizontal axis lists the models, presented in a left-to-right sequence without explicit labeling, while the vertical axis represents the average performance percentage, scaled linearly from 0 to 60 with labeled tick marks at intervals of 20. Each bar is color-coded and labeled with its exact performance value: the first bar is dark green and shows 68.66%, the second is purple at 61.11%, the third is teal at 29.44%, the fourth is magenta at 66.41%, the fifth is light blue at 62.98%, the sixth is brown at 36.62%, the seventh is light purple at 65.77%, the eighth is orange at 55.69%, the ninth is beige at 55.00%, the tenth is gray at 55.30%, the eleventh is light green at 52.61%, and the twelfth is light pink at 55.55%. The bars are not sorted by height and appear to be presented in the order they were evaluated or listed in the source material. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their color and numerical labels. The chart does not include a legend or explicit grouping, and the performance values are presented as discrete, individual measurements without indicating any stratification into tiers.
